criteria.text: The entry screen matches the drawing: a "Harbour" eyebrow, a "Tide Board" title, and a **Help** link in the **top-right** of the head.
A **flush tab bar** runs edge to edge under the head — Readings / Sources / History — with the current tab underlined. There is no gap at either end.
A **Save reading** button carries a small square icon, 16px inside a 34px control, with the label beside it on one line.
A **Publish board** button is the blue primary action, 160px wide, with "Publish board" on **one line**.
An **Export CSV** button sits beside Publish.
A **stale-readings chip** reads "2 readings stale" and is **red** (#c0392b) — it is a warning, and it must not read as a healthy state.

A **notice** under the buttons reads "Readings older than six hours are hidden from the public board automatically." It is 230px wide and, as drawn, it takes **two lines**. That is correct, not a defect.
**Open the board** is the only way onto the second screen. There is no address for it: a person gets there by clicking.
On the board screen, a note box and a **Lock the board** button. **Lock refuses while the note is blank**, and publishes once a note is written.
